note: Both sets reproduce most of Table 5.5-1 correctly and both share the same fabricated "[lines to]" quotes and the same wrong M2 thickness of 190 mm (table says 100 mm). Set A additionally captures real prose facts the page supports and B omits: the UV-driven protected-aluminum requirement on the first two mirrors, the rays being collimated after M3 and converging to a common on-axis pupil plane, and the coronagraph/starshade field directions. Set B adds its own errors (M2 radius of curvature given as -1,983 mm instead of -1,953 mm, a unit-converted 19.800 m with an invented quote, and a "tertiary mirror = M3" claim whose quote does not identify M3), while A's main defect is the invented "obscuration to next optic 9,030 mm" for M2. A also carries more duplicate/trivial claims, but its wrong claims are fewer and it covers more of the important content.
